title: 4 Cover Letter RED FLAGS (Avoid These Mistakes!)
description:
Your cover letter is the reason recruiters are ghosting you, even when you meet every requirement. In this video I break down the 4 cover letter red flags that get you rejected in seconds and show you the exact 5-part structure my student Tim used to secure an Analyst offer at JP Morgan as an international student from a non-target university.

IN THIS VIDEO:
0:00 Why your cover letter is getting you ghosted
0:20 Mistake 1: Thinking cover letters don't matter
1:18 Mistake 2: Writing a lifelong blog
2:21 Tim's JP Morgan name-drop (22% stat)
5:34 Mistake 3: Writing like a formal essay
6:26 The 5-part cover letter structure
7:23 Mistake 4: Being too generic
7:54 Value section: real examples
8:52 What to do now

I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
